# obix-core-forms

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-core-forms
```

> **Not yet on npm.** The OBIX packages are prepared for publication and are published only on the owner's authorisation; until then this is the command the published package will answer to.

## Basic usage

```js
import { createFormEngine } from 'obix-core-forms';
```

## API surface

- `obix-core-forms` — 1 value export: `createFormEngine`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-core-forms` is a **public building block**: the umbrella `obix` depends on it and re-exports its stable API, so applications normally reach it through `obix`; it can also be installed on its own.

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): no other OBIX package.
- Used by (OBIX): [`obix`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix).

## Testing

- 1 test file ships in the npm package (`__tests__/`): it is the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be read — not runtime code (no entry point reaches it).
- Run them with `npm test` (`vitest run`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, Vitest, TypeScript).
